              James Maxwell shared this
          
        

      
        Over the past 12 months, we've 10X'd our creative output for paid social— and it's largely down to how the team have improved processes and maintained focus.

The numbers from just the last 30 days:
  
🚀 1,730 ads shipped 📦 145 batches processed ⏱️ 202 hours saved
  
For a global marketing team running acquisition across 20 send countries, that's not just a productivity stat — it's hours my team gets back for strategy, testing, and the creative thinking that actually moves performance, instead of repetitive production work.

Well done Ludvig Alm, Jesse Cherubini, Aidan Isik, Antonio Eid and the creative team
and the best part we are just getting started
  
If you're leading a marketing or creative ops team and still building ads one at a time, I wo
